name: Printing
description: Receipt, kitchen and label printing from the device you have connected.

agent.description: Configures printing: ticket header/footer, paper width, auto-print on sale, and routing of order items to kitchen/bar stations. Actual printing and the cash drawer are driven by the device registered as a print host, which drains the hub's queue over the runtime WebSocket (ADR-0196).

ai.description: Retrieves the printing settings (paper width, auto-print and auto-open-drawer on sale). The receipt header and footer are NOT set here: the ticket is composed from the till settings (`sales.pos_settings.get`)
Updates the printing settings (paper width/auto-print/auto-open-drawer). It cannot change the receipt header or footer: those belong to the till settings (`sales.settings.update`)
Sends a document (receipt, kitchen order, label…) to the hub's print queue; jobId dedups repeated requests
